question: Can an exact-Jaccard margin reject option selected only on earlier physical runs recover recorded parent pointers at high precision and useful coverage on later, run-disjoint snapshot-887 runs?
scientific_role: Development-only masked-parent recovery and corruption-audit extension for the tree-native Decision Corpus; not a prospective Target-522 result, semantic lineage truth, orphan-edge validation, predictor effect, or search-utility claim.

population.eligible_edge: recorded child and parent are both present and fingerprint-valid, parent depth equals child depth minus one, and the same-run exact-preceding-depth candidate set has at least two members
population.prediction: the unique maximum-Jaccard candidate; a top tie is rejected

run_disjoint_split.ordering: the byte order of provisional_runs.jsonl in the immutable snapshot

confidence_rule.margin: largest exact Jaccard minus second-largest exact Jaccard within the fixed candidate set
confidence_rule.candidate_thresholds: all distinct positive margins among unique-top train predictions
confidence_rule.acceptance: unique top and margin at least the selected threshold
confidence_rule.selection: among thresholds satisfying the train precision target and minimum support, maximize accepted train edges; break any remaining tie toward the smaller exact threshold
confidence_rule.selection_failure: if no threshold qualifies, emit no test-selected rule and classify below gate

mandatory_denominator_report.all_wrong_alternative_micro: confident wrong unique tops divided by every wrong candidate across test children
mandatory_denominator_report.uniform_one_wrong_substitution_per_child: mean over test children of confident-wrong indicator divided by wrong-candidate count
mandatory_denominator_report.child_level_adversarial: test children with a confidently accepted wrong top divided by all ambiguous test children

classification_rule: Integrity or hard-support failure takes precedence. The strongest status requires every hard-support and primary gate. Precision-only requires hard support except the minimum test accepted/coverage gates, plus test precision at least 49/50; it cannot rescue the primary. All other valid executions are below gate.
mandatory_outputs: exact selected threshold and train selection support
unfiltered and selective train/test precision and coverage
test task/run anonymous breadth and anti-dominance

claim_boundary.allowed_if_positive: On a predeclared chronological run split of the disclosed development snapshot, an earlier-run-selected reject threshold recovers recorded exact-depth parent pointers at the stated precision and coverage; this supports an optional self-audit suggestion layer, not silent canonical rewrites.

forbidden_inputs: prospective first-960 or Target-300 labels, outcomes, grades, prediction values, accuracy, or search utility
Target-522 candidate identity or increment profile
test recorded-parent correctness during threshold selection
